rules.sentence: The most significant infectious complication would be a spinal cord abscess.
The risk of infection following a spinal cord stimulator placement is between 2.5 and 12 percent.
A dural puncture can cause a post-dural headache in up to 70% of patients.
A spinal epidural hematoma is the most significant adverse to spinal cord stimulator placement.
The incidence of a spinal epidural hematoma is 0.71%.
This emergency would require immediate neurosurgical decompression of the hematoma.
